page.notes: Several words are uncertain in the scan: "Confu!-" and "Ambitiofiffimam" are read as printed; the line "Verùm illis qualicunque fucceffu" is the printed "fucceffu nun-" with the catchword "horum" at the foot. "Umbra" is read as printed (Umbra fem-per); "Litera" is printed with a small-capital hint and may be a misreading of "Literæ". Where a word is broken across lines the hyphen is kept as printed. The left edge of the scan is dark and some letters near the gutter are hard to read; the transcription of the first column's final lines and the second column's middle is the least certain. Text is set in roman with italic words as printed.
